title: Centralize repeated workspace dependencies
why: Repeating the same dependency requirement across several members creates multiple update sites for one workspace-wide policy.
suggestion: Declare the version once in workspace.dependencies and use workspace = true from each member.
limitations: The rule requires the same direct registry requirement in at least three internal or private production members; published packages are excluded.
Member-specific feature additions remain compatible with workspace inheritance and do not need to be centralized.
